stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 31 to emphasize the main point of this story and bring it to a more effective close?

options.label: A
options.text: Since that day I’ve obviously made some other friends, but Carl is still a great neighbor to us.

options.label: B
options.text: It’s absolutely true that Carl is one of the greatest people who has ever lived in this neighborhood.

options.label: C
options.text: I’ll always be grateful to Carl, not only for the friendship but for the lessons he has taught me.

options.label: D
options.text: I’ve lived here for more than a year now, and I’ve watched Carl make even more friends.
